article.headline: Watkins has 15 points, 11 rebounds and six blocks, No. 4 USC women beat Saint Joseph's at Baha Mar
article.description: — JuJu Watkins had 15 points, 11 rebounds and six blocks, Jazzy Davidson also scored 15 points and No. 4 USC beat Saint Joseph's 71-55 on Friday at the Baha Mar Nassau Championship.
article.linkText: Watkins has 15 points, 11 rebounds and six blocks, No. 4 USC women beat Saint Joseph's at Baha Mar
article.story: NASSAU, Bahamas -- — JuJu Watkins had 15 points, 11 rebounds and six blocks, Jazzy Davidson also scored 15 points and No. 4 USC beat Saint Joseph's 71-55 on Friday at the Baha Mar Nassau Championship. Watkins added five assists and two steals for the Trojans (6-1), who never trailed in the game. Saniyah Hall had 13 points and Sara Okeke scored 10. Gabby Casey led Saint Joseph's (4-2) with 16 points and seven rebounds. Maddy Potts made three 3-pointers and finished with 11 points. Hall scored seven points before Davidson hit a 3-pointer to make it 16-2 midway through the first quarter, and the Trojans led by double figures for more than 36 minutes to the finish. USC used a 16-2 opening run in the second quarter to take its biggest lead at 41-14 with a couple of minutes left before halftime. The Hawks shot 37% (23 of 63) from the field, made 5 of 17 from 3-point range and were just 4 of 9 from the foul line. Up next USC: Plays Iowa State on Sunday. Saint Joseph's: Plays No. 20 Illinois on Sunday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college football coverage here
